label: sdc02_0240_bbteacher_01
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Are you ready to travel to Area Zero,\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]?[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc02_0240_bbteacher_02
text: I don’t mean to rush you, but...just keep in mind\nthat I’m positively itching to get going![VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc02_0240_bbteacher_03
text: Splendid! We’re finally ready to set off, then![VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc02_0240_bbteacher_04
text: Are you two feeling all right? Well enough to\ntravel, at least?[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc02_0240_brother_02
text: I’ve had time to calm down.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc02_0240_brother_03
text: I’m fine... I know what I have to do now.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc02_0240_brother_04
text: I’ll find this Legendary Pokémon in Area Zero...\nNo matter what it takes![VAR 0x0114(0043)]
